name: OpenWorkbook
label: Open Excel Workbook
description: Opens or reuses an Excel workbook in an existing Excel instance by workbook name.

fields.name: WorkbookName
fields.label: Workbook Name
fields.description: Workbook file name to open (example: Report.xlsx).

fields.name: OpenAsReadOnly
fields.label: Open as ReadOnly
fields.description: If set to true, the workbook will be opened in read-only mode, preventing any changes from being saved.

fields.name: ReadProtectionPassword
fields.label: Read Protection Password
fields.description: Password required to open the workbook if it is protected with a read password.

fields.name: WorkbookInstance
fields.label: Workbook Instance
fields.description: The Excel workbook instance that is opened or reused. This output can be used in subsequent Excel activities.
